ruleset.name: Singapore MOM Enhanced Heat Stress Framework
ruleset.description: HeatShift uses the enhanced Singapore MOM Heat Stress Management Framework taking effect on 1 December 2026.

wbgt_monitoring.description: WBGT must be monitored hourly during work hours. HeatShift treats this as a workplace monitoring requirement rather than a schedule-level constraint.

heavy_physical_work_rest.description: For heavy physical outdoor work, WBGT of 32°C or above requires at least 10 minutes of continuous rest every hour. At 33°C or above, the minimum increases to 15 minutes every hour, with longer rest recommended as WBGT increases. HeatShift validates the timing and duration of rest from schedule data but does not automatically verify the physical suitability of the rest area.

adequate_rest_under_shade.description: Required rest should be provided under suitable shade. HeatShift does not automatically verify the physical rest environment.

hydration.description: Workers should rehydrate regularly below 31°C and at least hourly from 31°C and above. The recommended 300 mL per hour is guidance rather than a hard individual consumption requirement. HeatShift does not attempt to verify whether individual workers actually consumed water.

acclimatisation.description: Workers requiring acclimatisation should gradually increase their daily heat exposure over at least 7 days. HeatShift does not store individual worker acclimatisation or health profiles in the MVP.

heat_stress_training.description: Establish a heat stress training programme for workers exposed to heat.

cool_drinking_water.description: Provide cool drinking water near work areas.

emergency_cooling_supplies.description: Keep cold water, ice packs or water spray on standby for emergency response.

suitable_heat_protective_clothing.description: Provide suitable clothing that can mitigate or protect workers from excessive heat stress.

reschedule_outdoor_physical_work_to_cool.description: Reschedule outdoor physical work to cooler periods where feasible.

shaded_rest_area.description: Provide shaded rest areas that are well ventilated and well insulated or cooled.

cool_rest_or_work_area.description: Consider measures such as fans or air coolers to provide cooler rest or work areas where appropriate.

buddy_system.description: Workers should look out for each other for signs of heat-related illness.

monitor_vulnerable_workers.description: HeatShift does not store or infer individual worker health profiles in the MVP.

redeploy_vulnerable_workers.description: Consider redeployment of vulnerable workers to non-outdoor work where appropriate. Individual vulnerability is not modeled in the MVP.

longer_rest_as_wbgt_increases.description: Consider longer rest periods as WBGT increases, particularly at higher WBGT levels.

hydration_validation.reason: The MVP does not have individual hydration tracking.

acclimatisation_validation.reason: The MVP does not contain individual worker acclimatisation profiles.

automatic_stop_work.description: MOM does not prescribe one universal WBGT threshold at which all outdoor work must automatically stop. HeatShift instead evaluates applicable controls, task characteristics and available alternatives.

rescheduling.description: Failure to reschedule outdoor physical work does not by itself make a schedule invalid if applicable mandatory safety controls are satisfied.

included: 10-minute hourly rest validation at WBGT 32 to less than 33
15-minute hourly rest validation at WBGT 33 and above
not_modeled: automatic verification of workplace equipment or supplies
mvp_scope.reason: The MVP focuses on schedule-level heat safety and supervisor-level workplace compliance without storing unnecessary individual health information or claiming to automatically verify physical workplace conditions.

hard_schedule_safety_constraints.purpose: Deterministic Python logic must reject or modify candidate schedules that violate mandatory heavy-work rest requirements.

workplace_safety_requirements.purpose: HeatShift reports workplace safety requirements separately and uses supervisor confirmation rather than pretending the schedule itself proves compliance.

mandatory_workplace_measures.purpose: HeatShift provides a separate checklist for the four measures becoming mandatory on 1 December 2026.

recommended_practices.purpose: The AI agent uses these measures as planning preferences when generating, comparing and scoring alternative schedules.
